description: Start a new browser task from a goal and optional URL. Use this when you want the runtime to visit, read, or act on a site now; use session tools for continuity and get_task to inspect a saved run.

agent_kind.description: Planner backend to use for this run.

agent_model.description: Optional planner model override for this run. Auto, PI, and OpenCode use the catalog-backed selection when set. Defaults to deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.

agent_variant.description: Optional planner thinking variant override for this run. Defaults to high for catalog-backed planners.

goal.description: What the browser task should accomplish right now.

headless.description: Whether to prefer headless browser mode for this run.

input.description: Structured task inputs that the recipe or planner can reference.

max_steps.description: Maximum browser steps before the run stops.

mode.description: Task mode: read for extraction or research, act for interactive changes.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema-like object used to validate the final structured result.

profile.description: Optional named browser profile for authenticated or warmed browser state.

recipe_id.description: Optional starter recipe id when you want a known flow instead of a purely freeform run.

session_id.description: Optional saved session to reuse when this task should continue earlier browser state or context.

start_url.description: Optional starting URL when you already know where the task should begin.

name: webtask_run
title: Run Web Task
